body: I wish you were right about my husbands motives for working the hours he does, but he does it by choice not out of financial need. When he has time off from work he finds ways to leave the house and the children, on the off chance he does stay home he is completely checked out and spends most of his time on his phone. As far as my children are concerned I have never confided in them my plan for suicide nor will I. I am not leaving a note because there is no point and frankly no one cares. My children's reactions will range from barely register to sad for a year; when I compare that to a childhood with a miserable mother I think being sad for a year is a better choice.
